Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the shared game board: the turn-order tile, the set of player tiles and the four card/building rows (top and bottom for cards and buildings). Provides the operations to pick, add, move and discard those elements during a game. Getters return defensive copies of the lists.
